name: Task Form
description: A modal overlay used to create a new task or edit an existing one — the single point of data entry for task title, due date, and status.
entry_points: Clicking 'Add Task' on the Task List (opens in create mode, empty fields, status defaults to Todo)
Clicking the edit button on a task in the Task List (opens in edit mode, pre-filled with that task's current values)
information_displayed: Modal title ('New Task' or 'Edit Task' depending on mode)

available_actions.description: Validates and saves the title, due date, and status; on success closes the modal and returns to the Task List.
Closes the modal without saving, discarding any entered changes.

business_rules: Title is required — cannot save without one
A title consisting only of whitespace is treated as missing
Status defaults to 'Todo' when creating a new task
Title cannot be cleared to empty when editing an existing task
Status can be freely changed when editing
edge_cases: User closes the modal via the X icon, Escape key, or clicking outside — treated the same as Cancel
User submits with only whitespace in the title — treated as missing title
User tries to save while a save is already in progress (double-click Save) — should not trigger a duplicate save
